evidence.title: ATS Resume Checker — Simulate the ATS Scan | Kickresume

name: ATS Resume Checker
summary: Web checker that simulates an applicant tracking system scan and scores a resume against more than 20 checks.
description: An online tool that simulates an ATS scan of a resume: it checks whether the file is scannable, runs over 20 checks against a database of successful CVs, and returns a score with improvement tips. It also offers AI resume grading and review next to the checker.
